is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles coluzzii, a member of the Anopheles gambiae complex (page 1, 3).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study reports genotyping for Vgsc L995F (1014F), Vgsc L995S (1014S), and Vgsc N1570Y (1575Y) (page 1, 5, 8).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Genotype frequencies for 1014F are provided in Figure 4a and described in the text (page 8). The sample size for genotyping is 32 F0 females (page 5, 8).

african_field_population.evidence: Larvae were collected from field sites in Port Harcourt, Nigeria (page 3).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an original empirical research article (page 1).

sub_country_location.evidence: The study specifies collection sites in Obio/Akpor Government Area, Port Harcourt, Rivers State, Nigeria (page 3).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Larval collection was conducted in October and November 2019 (page 3).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes a new, specific collection of larvae in 2019 for this research.

supplement.evidence: All necessary data, including genotype counts and frequencies, are provided in the main text and figures.

assessment.summary: This study characterizes insecticide resistance in Anopheles coluzzii from Port Harcourt, Nigeria. It reports high resistance to pyrethroids and DDT, with evidence of metabolic resistance (P450s/GSTs) and high frequency of the 1014F kdr mutation, alongside the first detection of the 1575Y mutation in this region.
